Experience.GainsEmpty: No gain logged: + adds a session's experience, and the Total adds itself up.

RollSelection.SelectBothWarning: Select an Ability and a second trait to roll.

Arete.Label: Arete
Arete.RollHint: Roll Attribute, Skill, Skill (one is enough); Arete is the prize of the description
Arete.SelectTraitWarning: Pick at least one trait: an Attribute or a Skill.
Arete.WitnessesHint: Someone saw you do it, +2 Paradox.
Arete.NoSpheres: No Sphere with dots: unlock Spheres in Magick to use them here.
Arete.PrizeHint: If the description honours the Instrument, or the Creed, or invents an effect beyond the tables: extra dice equal to Arete ({arete}), within the +3 cap together with Harmony and Bonuses.
Arete.PrizeHybrid: Hybrid Magick never takes the prize.
Arete.HarmonyHint: The dice other Mages give you: one from anyone sharing your Creed or your Type, two from anyone sharing both, always with a Sphere in common. Count them at the table. Magick and Technomagick do not harmonise with each other; Hybrid does with both.
Arete.ThresholdHint: The threshold is the higher of the highest Sphere and the highest Scope, +1 per Scope beyond the first, +1 with three or more Spheres, capped at 7. Click the dots: the Sphere level you use, the level of each Scope.
Arete.AutoVictory: Automatic victory: the pool is at least twice the threshold, no roll. In Vulgar Magick only the red dice are rolled.
Arete.AutoVictoryChat: Automatic victory: pool {pool} against threshold {threshold}, no roll.
Arete.RedOnly: Automatic victory (pool {pool}, threshold {threshold}): only the red dice are rolled. If Backlash strikes, Burn {burn}, equal to the threshold.
Arete.OneStep: One step short: {missing} successes missing, within Arete ({arete}). Success at a price.
Arete.SpecialtyHint: Speciality: this Scope counts as the lower of the Sphere and its own level, and does not weigh as an extra Scope.
Arete.ThresholdShort: Threshold: the higher of Sphere and Scope, +1 per Scope beyond the first, +1 with three Spheres, capped at 7.

Focus.CredoHint: One of the twelve, or in your own words
Focus.TypeHint: Decides which Instrument families you use
Focus.InstrumentsHint: One per Sphere: without its Instrument in the scene, you cannot cast with that Sphere. The specific one is yours to write.
Focus.SharedTool: Also carries {others}: lose it, lose both.
Focus.NoSpheres: No Sphere unlocked: every Sphere you activate in Magick takes its Instrument here.
Focus.SpheresEmpty: No Sphere unlocked: the ones you activate in Magick appear here, with their notes.

ConceptChallenge.Label: The Concept Challenge
ConceptChallenge.Hint: Answer in writing: rough notes are enough. There is no right order, so begin with the group that inspires you most.

description.Label: Description
description.Prompt: What first impression do they make on a stranger, or on two people exchanging a few words?

mask.Label: The Mask
mask.Prompt: What do others believe about them at first glance, and what is only a façade?

routine.Label: The Routine
routine.Prompt: What is their typical day like? What ritual could they never give up, no matter how boring?

livelihood.Label: The Livelihood
livelihood.Prompt: What work have they done? Do they choose from passion, necessity, or jump from job to job?

spark.Label: Spark
spark.Prompt: Name three talents or virtues anyone would recognize in them.

cracks.Label: Cracks
cracks.Prompt: Name two flaws, quirks, or vices that complicate their life or relationships.

outlet.Label: Release Valve
outlet.Prompt: What makes them feel good right away: a beer, an engine, or an endless TV series?

roots.Label: Roots
roots.Prompt: What was their adolescence like? At the center of the group, on the margins, a rebel, or just passing through?

skeleton.Label: Skeleton in the Closet
skeleton.Prompt: An error, secret, or regret they pray will never resurface.

monster.Label: The Monster under the Bed
monster.Prompt: Their most irrational fear: nothing supernatural, but spiders, heights, or going home alone.

pressure.Label: Under Pressure
pressure.Prompt: When everything slips from their grasp, do they explode, shut down, run, think, lie, or analyze coldly?

redLine.Label: The Red Line
redLine.Prompt: The one thing they would refuse to do, no matter how high the stakes.

refuge.Label: The Refuge
refuge.Prompt: Where do they go, or what do they do, when they only want to disappear for a couple of hours?

superstition.Label: Profane Superstition
superstition.Prompt: An ordinary fixation or superstition, such as a recurring routine or an object chosen blindly.

beacon.Label: Beacon
beacon.Prompt: The most important human person in their life today: a partner, parent, child, friend, or trusted doctor.

thorn.Label: Thorn in the Side
thorn.Prompt: Their everyday antagonist: an intrusive neighbor, an unfair boss, a resentful ex. Why?

securityBlanket.Label: The Security Blanket
securityBlanket.Prompt: A commonplace but irreplaceable object they always carry.

lastSupper.Label: The Last Supper
lastSupper.Prompt: If the world ended tomorrow, how and with whom would they spend their final evening as a mortal?

drive.Label: Drive
drive.Prompt: The dream that makes them human, the inspiration behind their Awakening.

embodiment.Label: Embodiment
embodiment.Prompt: Up to three things they, the player, and the storyteller have in common: a hobby, fear, or ideal.

distance.Label: Distance
distance.Prompt: At least three things in which you are profoundly different: the boundary between you and them.

Scopes.Label: Scopes
Scopes.TableHint: Each Scope is declared with a level from 1 to 7. The threshold is the higher of the highest Sphere and the highest Scope; every Scope beyond the first raises it by 1. Potency: damage per level. Duration: when you cast, say whether it runs on play or on narrative time.

OngoingMagick.Label: Ongoing Magick
OngoingMagick.MaintainedAdded: “{name}” is now among the Ongoing Magicks.

Spheres.Hint: Select the Spheres to display and assign each a rating from zero to five.
Spheres.Empty: Select at least one Sphere from the list above.
Spheres.FamilyHint: The house marks the family Spheres: the ones your Family, Subfamily and Creed open to you, which cost less than outside Spheres.
Spheres.FamilyOn: Family Sphere: costs less. Click to make it outside.
Spheres.FamilyOff: Outside Sphere. Click to make it a family one.

Wisdom.Label: Wisdom
Wisdom.SegnatoEffects: two fewer dice on mortal rolls, mundane scenes cost, no Consensus mending, your aura shows.

MagickBalance.SideFull: This side of the Magick track is already full.
MagickBalance.ParadoxGained: Vulgar Magick: the Wheel moves {amount} step(s) toward Paradox.
MagickBalance.ParadoxReverted: Roll cancelled: the Wheel is back where it was.
MagickBalance.FloorReached: Permanent Paradox is the floor: the Wheel goes no lower.

Bonuses.Empty: No Bonus noted: + adds one (e.g. +3 · Dice · Strength rolls). Cap +3.
Bonuses.Cap: +3 cap: written Bonuses, the Arete prize and Harmony share three dice at most.

Belongings.Name: Name
Belongings.SharedEmpty: Nothing shared: + adds a shared Background, Advantage or Flaw with its dot rating.
Belongings.StoryEmpty: Nothing from the story: + adds what the chronicle gave (or took), with its dot rating.

Personaggio.AnchorsHint: Usually three: the people keeping you tied to the world.
Personaggio.ConvictionsHint: Usually three, each tied to a catalogue group.

Salute.Label: Health
Salute.ClickHint: Click: pick the mark. Right click: the box clears.
Salute.KoDeath: KO: every box is aggravated and physical damage prevails. Death.
Salute.KoShock: KO: every box is aggravated and mental damage prevails. Coma or shock.
Salute.PickHint: One mark per box: physical or mental, superficial or aggravated.
Salute.NewSessionHint: Every mental superficial heals, one physical superficial goes away, the Backlash can be denied again.
Salute.NewSessionDone: New session: mental superficial healed, one physical superficial removed, Backlash re-armed.
Salute.ResetHint: The track goes back to empty.

Contraccolpo.Label: Deny the Backlash
Contraccolpo.Hint: Once per session: mark one mental aggravated, the Backlash does not strike, the Wheel rises by 3. That aggravated box does not heal until those points are discharged. "New session" re-arms it.
Contraccolpo.Done: Backlash denied: one mental aggravated, the Wheel rises by {amount}.
Contraccolpo.AlreadyUsed: The Backlash has already been denied this session.
Contraccolpo.NoRoom: No box left for the mental aggravated: the whole track is aggravated.
Contraccolpo.WheelFull: The three points bring the Wheel to its maximum: paradox Flaw or default burst.

Specialties.Label: Specialties
Specialties.Name: Specialty
Specialties.Hint: Worth one extra die whenever the specialty applies to the roll.
Specialties.Empty: No Specialty: + adds one (Skill and name).
Specialties.Incomplete: A Skill and the Specialty name are both needed.

SphereSpecialties.Label: Sphere Specialities
SphereSpecialties.Hint: At the third dot of a Sphere, pick one of its passive powers; the fourth and fifth dots each grant another. There is no Affinity Sphere any more.
SphereSpecialties.Empty: No Sphere at its third dot: the Speciality comes with the third.
SphereSpecialties.MissingPack: The Spheres compendium is not available.
